entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this helmet I bought, and I want it done now. This is completely unacceptable.
I can certainly help you with a return. I'm sorry to hear you had a long wait. To get started, could I have your order number?
It's VF-8675309. And don't give me a runaround. I want a refund.

Thank you for that, one moment while I pull it up. Okay, I see the order for the AeroFlow helmet. To make sure I'm documenting this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

The issue is I don't want it! The color looks nothing like it did online. It's hideous. I'm not compromising my safety by wearing something I hate just because your pictures are misleading. Get me your manager, I'm not dealing with this.

I understand your frustration with the color difference, and I assure you, I can handle this return for you directly without needing a manager. I just need to confirm a few details. You mentioned it's a color preference, and not a defect, correct?
Yes, I just said that! The box is unopened, I took one look at it and knew I'd never wear it. I want to send it back. Are you going to process this or not? I will light you up on social media.
Of course, I'm happy to process that for you right now. I see you received the item 71 days ago. Our standard return policy is 90 days, so you are well within the timeframe for a full refund.
Well, it's about time. So what happens now?

I've just generated a pre-paid return label and sent it to the email address on your account. Since the box is unopened, you can simply attach that label and drop it off with the carrier. Once our warehouse receives the helmet, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Fine. A full refund, you're sure?

Yes, absolutely. And listen, I do want to apologize again for the frustration with the product color and your hold time. I see here that you're one of our VIP customers, and we really value your business. I've gone ahead and added a $50 store credit to your account for you to use on a future purchase.
Oh. A $50 credit? Okay. Well... that's... fine. Thank you. Just make sure that email comes through.
It's already been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
